parsed.rationale: Very tall R waves with deep S waves in V2–V4 (voltage well above LVH thresholds) and left axis deviation, with only slight concave J-point/ST elevation in V2–V3 and prominent T waves that fit LVH repolarization. There is no convex or tombstone ST elevation, no reciprocal ST depression and no pathologic Q waves, so STEMI criteria are not met on this tracing.
